# 🔧 Maintenance Checklist

- [ ] Review docs against source changes.
- [ ] Run documentation, asset, and repository validators.
- [ ] Compile using the documented GNU++17 toolchain.
- [ ] Run the CLI smoke test with synthetic temporary data.
- [ ] Review CodeQL findings.
- [ ] Review GitHub Actions and Dependabot updates.
- [ ] Review tracked sample-data privacy before public distribution.
- [ ] Update known issues and technical debt.
- [ ] Update changelog and roadmap when applicable.
- [ ] Record evidence and review date.
